_comment: Payroll-style invoicing (owner request 2026-11-24). basePay: monthly base pay per rep, keyed by the rep's GHL user id (the name is a label only); a rep not listed is commission-only and gets no base invoice. periods: bi-weekly pay periods of lengthDays days starting on firstStart (a Monday, America/New_York) and repeating every lengthDays; workingDays are the weekday numbers that count (1 = Monday ... 5 = Friday). workedDayMinDials: a working day counts as worked when the rep made at least this many outbound human dials that day (one per call ID, automated calls excluded); fewer is a Non-paid day off unless an admin overrides the day. holidays: unpaid days (YYYY-MM-DD, with a name) excluded from the month's working-day count, so they neither lower the daily rate nor count as a deduction; optional: true marks an optional work day, paid at the daily rate when the rep makes workedDayMinDials+ dials, otherwise a holiday with no deduction. dailyRate = monthly base ÷ working days in that calendar month (holidays excluded); a period that spans two months uses each month's rate for its own days. recipients: every invoice email goes To 'to' with 'cc' in the Cc header; from is the sender shown (the Gmail account that sends is GMAIL_USER in .env, which must be this address or one of its aliases). monthlySummary: who gets the summary of invoices due on the 1st of each month, and at what hour (America/New_York). numberPrefix: invoice numbers are <prefix>-<rep initials>-<YYYYMMDD>-<type>. paymentTerms and payer are printed on the PDF. Approvers are the 'approvers' list in config/invoices.json. Editable without code; the server re-reads the file when it changes.
paymentTerms: Payable by Intelagent Media within 7 days of approval. Base pay and commission are estimated from dashboard counts; the approved invoice is the record.
